description: Remove duplicate URL strings while preserving first-seen order
acceptance: Exact duplicate URL strings are removed, preserving the first occurrence: ["https://a.test", "https://b.test", "https://a.test"] yields ["https://a.test", "https://b.test"].
An empty iterable yields an empty list; already unique input retains its order.
All-identical input yields one URL; adjacent and separated duplicates behave identically.
Comparison uses exact strings: case, trailing slashes, fragments and query ordering are not normalized.
The helper accepts an iterable of strings, including a one-pass generator, returns a new list, and does not mutate an input list.
